Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The players are out in the middle. David Warner and Aaron Finch will open the batting for Australia. Maheesh Theekshana will begin with the ball. Let's go!
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Every game Australia just keeps proving why they are the World T20 Champions! Everything going right for Australia! They started the innings by grabbing two wickets but made sure they finished strongly as well. They once again grabbed wickets in a heap towards the end of the innings. Jhye Richardson and Kane Richardson picked up 7 wickets between them, while Glenn Maxwell grabbed two. Josh Hazlewood might have not grabbed a wicket but he was very economical in his spell. So, Australia have an opportunity here to clinch the T20I series. Can the openers do the job once again? We will find out. Stay tuned for the run chase.

Batting woes for Sri Lanka continue. They came out to bat with some aggressive intent. It was surely not the wrong approach but their plan did backfire as they lost two quick wickets within the Powerplay. Post that, Charith Asalanka and Kusal Mendis did some sort of repair work. They put on 66 runs together and steadied the Sri Lankan ship. But once Charith Asalanka perished, all the other batters fell like a pack of cards. They have failed to get even past their total in the first T20I. The Sri Lankan bowlers face another tough challenge ahead of them.

It's been the same story for both teams as compared to the first T20I. Australia once again were scintillating with the ball and the hosts were disappointing with the bat. Australia started the innings brilliantly and have ended the same way. Another clinical performance for the visitors in the field. At the pitch report, Russel Arnold informed us that it was a wicket where 170 could be achieved but Sri Lanka have managed to put an under-par total of 124.

Good running! Length ball, at the stumps. Nuwan Thushara heaves it towards wide long on and hurries back for the second. The throw is just a bit wide and Matthew Wade cannot reach the stumps. Two taken. Sri Lanka finish with 124/9!
Full and around off, drilled down to long off for a single.
Nuwan Thushara is the last man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Another one bites the dust and this has just gone from bad to worse for the hosts. Kane Richardson just keeps bowling it a bit slower and into the deck. This is well outside the off stump and Chamika Karunaratne shuffles across a long way trying to swing across. The ball goes a long way up into the night sky and around wide long on. Ashton Agar moves to his right and takes yet another very well-judged catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Ashton Agar b Kane Richardson

Commentary.Commentary: No hat-trick! Slower again, into the pitch and outside off. Chamika Karunaratne can only manage to nudge it onto the leg side. No run so far in the final over.
Maheesh Theekshana walks out to bat.

OUT! TAKEN! Team hat-trick for Sri Lanka and Kane Richardson is on a hat-trick as well! Pitched up around off, Dushmantha Chameera backs away and just goes after it. Chameera swings hard and gets a lot of elevation on it but no timing. Ashton Agar settles under it at the long on fence and takes an assured catch. Kane Richardson has his third and Sri Lanka just getting no momentum whatsoever heading into the break.
Commentary.Howout: c Ashton Agar b Kane Richardson

Commentary.Commentary: Dushmantha Chameera comes to the crease.

OUT! CAUGHT! Straight to the man! This is short and wide from Kane Richardson but once again the pace is taken off the ball. Dasun Shanaka hangs deep in his crease and throws his hands at it. The ball is just a bit too wide and Shanaka cannot control the shot. The ball is hit hard but straight towards Aaron Finch at cover and he takes s sharp catch over there. Sri Lanka going down in a hurry here.
Commentary.Howout: c Aaron Finch b Kane Richardson

Commentary.Commentary: Chamika Karunaratne is the new man in. Also, Kane Richardson comes to bowl the final over.

OUT! CAUGHT! Jhye Richardson does have the last laugh and picks up his third wicket in the match. Richardson goes slower and into the deck. This is bowled wider of the off stump as well. Wanindu Hasaranga has to reach for it as he tries to lift it over covers. The ball goes high off the bottom part of the bat and David Warner takes an assured catch around the cover region.
Commentary.Howout: c David Warner b Jhye Richardson

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Now, that is muscled! Jhye Richardson looks for the yorker but misses the mark and serves it right in the slot. Hasaranga clears the front leg and thumps it past mid on for a boundary.

FOUR! Edgy boundary but Wanindu Hasaranga certainly won't mind it. Hasaranga moves a bit in his crease and Jhye Richardson just bowls it on off. Hasaranga throws his hands at it and gets a thick outside edge. Matthew Wade has already taken a step to his left and can't adjust in time. The ball runs away to the third man fence.
Bangs in a bouncer now does Jhye Richardson. This is on middle and Hasaranga misses the ramp shot. No wide called for height, probably borderline.
Length and wide of the off stump, driven hard and on the up but straight to the man at sweeper cover for a single.
Hard length and angled into the body, Hasaranga dabs it down towards backward point for a quick single.
Back of a length, on off. Hasaranga taps it towards the man at third man and collects a run.
Shorter and on the body, flicked off the hips towards fine leg for a single.
Swing and a miss! A touch fuller and closer to the off pole. Dasun Shanaka swings across the line but doesn't connect. Three dots on the trot now and the pressure keeps on mounting.
On a good length and around off, Dasun Shanaka just looks to guide it behind square on the off side but is well beaten.
Smart bowling! Josh Hazlewood sees Shanaka backing away and follows him. Shanaka gets cramped for room and can only manage to block it out.

A direct hit and Wanindu Hasaranga was a goner! Fuller in length and angled into the legs, Hasaranga tucks it away towards mid-wicket and just sets off. Glenn Maxwell picks it up but misses the stumps at the bowler's end. Single taken!
Josh Hazlewood (3-1-13-0) comes back into the attack.
No run taken! Pitched up, on off and this is driven towards mid off but the batters opt not to go for the single.

FOUR! Beautifully placed by Dasun Shanaka. Length again, around middle. Shanaka backs away and just caresses it into the gap between backward point and short man for a boundary. Sri Lanka need more of the same from their skipper now;.
Fuller and on off, Dasun Shanaka goes hard at it and clears mid-wicket to pick up a couple of runs.
Length ball, on middle and this is driven on the up through mid on for a single.
Wanindu Hasaranga comes to the crease.

OUT! TAKEN! Soft, soft dismissal and Bhanuka Rajapaksa will be livid with himself. Kane Richardson bowls another slower and into the deck. This is around the hips and Rajapaksa just looks to help it over the fielder at short fine leg. Rajapaksa is way too early in the shot and due to the lack of pace, the ball loops up towards short fine leg where Josh Hazlewood takes a dolly of a catch. Sri Lanka lose their fifth and Australia on top of proceedings here.
Commentary.Howout: c Josh Hazlewood b Kane Richardson

Commentary.Commentary: Easy two! Back of a length and on leg stump, the pace is taken off the ball as well. Rajapaksa pulls it without much timing in front of square on the leg side for a brace.

On the pads, Bhanuka Rajapaksa stays inside the crease and works it through square leg. The batters think about the second run but settle for just the single. End of another tidy spell from Ashton Agar, 4-0-27-0!
On off, this is pushed through covers for an easy single.
On off, this is nudged away to the leg side.
Beaten! Flighted and around off, a bit of turn on offer again for Agar and Shanaka gets beaten past the outside edge one more time.

Peach of a delivery from Ashton Agar and even he is surprised. This is nicely drifted into middle, Dasun Shanaka looks to defend it out but the ball grips and turns away sharply, beating the outside edge by the minuscule of margins.
Down the leg side, swept away towards deep backward square leg for just a single.
Ashton Agar is back on.

FOUR! Edgy runs, but Sri Lanka will not mind that! Jhye Richardson hits the deck hard, down leg. Dasun Shanaka pulls this but the ball hurries onto him and it goes off the top edge towards fine leg for a boundary.
Tadd shorter, around middle. Dasun Shanaka looks to pull this but he gets an inside edge back onto his boot.
On a length, around middle. Dasun Shanaka defends it out.
Much fuller now, around middle. Bhanuka Rajapaksa pushes it down to long on for a single.
A length ball, nipping back in around middle. Dasun Shanaka tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
The skipper, Dasun Shanaka is in at number 6.

OUT! HIT WICKET! Oh, dear! A wicket falls at the wrong time for Sri Lanka and this was the last thing they needed! An unfortunate way to get out, but Australia have got rid of another set batter. A shorter ball, around middle. Kusal Mendis looks to pull this but he is a little early on his shot and he misses it. The ball hits him on his helmet, Mendis falls and he hits the stumps with his bat as he goes to ground.  Hope Mendis is fine but Jhye Richardson has his second wicket.
Jhye Richardson (2-0-10-1) is back into the attack.
Back of a length, around middle. Kusal Mendis pulls it towards deep square leg. Single taken! Kusal Mendis retains the strike!
Good-length delivery, around middle. Bhanuka Rajapaksa drags it with the inner half of his bat towards mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Down the leg side, shorter ball. Bhanuka Rajapaksa pulls it towards fine leg. Kane Richardson there runs forward, and puts in a dive but he fails to get there in time. The ball goes past him for a boundary.
Length ball, tighter line now, around the off pole. Bhanuka Rajapaksa hops and dabs it towards point.
Swing and a miss! Tad shorter, around off. Bhanuka Rajapaksa looks to pull this but he misses. A stifled appeal there, but the ball probably clipped his thigh pads.
Tad shorter, outside off. Bhanuka Rajapaksa guides it towards third man for a brace.
FOUR! Welcome boundary! Tosses it up, fuller one, around middle. Kusal Mendis gets down on his knee and sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Extra bounce! Tad shorter, outside off, spinning away. Kusal Mendis stays back and does well to cut it towards point.
Fuller now, around middle and leg. Bhanuka Rajapaksa leans forward and flicks it towards square leg for a single. He gets off the mark with that!
Back of a length, around middle. Kusal Mendis pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Another short-length delivery, outside off, spinning away. Kusal Mendis slashes it past point for a brace.
Shorter ball, around off. Kusal Mendis taps it towards point.
Fuller ball, around middle. Kusal Mendis sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single.
Bhanuka Rajapaksa is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Glenn Maxwell strikes once again! Good decision to bring him on again. Much-needed wicket for Australia. A fuller ball, spinning away, around off. Charith Asalanka shimmies down the track again, and tries to heave it on the leg side but the ball goes off the outside edge towards mid off. Aaron Finch there keeps his eyes on the ball and holds on to it.
Commentary.Howout: c Aaron Finch b Glenn Maxwell

Commentary.Commentary: Stumping chance missed! A fuller ball, this one comes in with the angle, down the leg side. Charith Asalanka steps down the track and tries to heave this on the leg side, but he misses. Matthew Wade fails to grab the ball as well.
Fuller ball, around middle. Kusal Mendis sweeps it hard to the fielder at mid-wicket. A slight midfield there allows the batters to take a single.
Short again, around off. Kusal Mendis makes room and lifts it over cover. Kane Richardson runs to his right and does well to stop the ball. Two taken!
Back of a length, around middle and off. Kusal Mendis miscues his pull shot to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Glenn Maxwell comes back into the attack.
Shorter ball now, around middle. Kusal Mendis knocks it down to long on for a single.

Swing and a miss! Well bowled! Turn and bounce for Agar! Loopy ball, slower through the air, fuller one, outside off, spinning away. Kusal Mendis gets down on his knee and tries to sweep this but he misses.
Tossed up delivery, pitches it up, around the pads, quicker one. Charith Asalanka works it towards deep mid-wicket. Only a single this time.
Good running! A shorter one now, darting it on the pads. Charith Asalanka steps down the track and flicks it aerially in the vacant mid-wicket region for a couple of runs.
Full again, tad quicker, now at around 91 clicks, around middle. Kusal Mendis drives it gently through cover for a single.
Tosses it up, full, around middle and leg. Kusal Mendis miscues his sweep shot towards deep square leg for a brace.
Ashton Agar is back on!
Length ball, around off. Mendis guides it towards backward point and picks up a quick run. At the halfway mark, Sri Lanka are 63/2!
FOUR! Delicately done! Good-length, closer to the off pole. Mendis opens the face of his blade at the very last moment and gets it between the keeper and the man at short third man for a boundary.
On a good length, outside off. Kusal Mendis looks to drive off the back foot but gets undone by the extra bit of bounce on offer.
Length this time, on off. Mendis keeps it out on the off side.
Back of a length, around leg stump. Asalanka nudges it off the back foot through square leg for one.

FOUR! Oh, no! What happened here? Short ball on the pads and Charith Asalanka just picks it up and flicks it aerially. The ball seems to be going straight down the throat of Mitchell Marsh on the backward square leg fence but unfortunately for him, Marsh slips. The ball goes just over his head, one bounce into the fence. A stroke of luck here for Asalanka.
Kane Richardson comes back to bowl. He went for 8 runs in his first over.
Slower delivery again, around the top of off. Mendis defends it from inside the crease.
This is dug into the pitch and Asalanka just pulls it powerfully to deep mid-wicket for a single.

Well bowled and good running as well. Kusal Mendis looks to shuffle across but Marsh sees it and bowls a slower length ball outside off. Mendis defends it back onto the deck and scampers through for a run.
A bit short and wide, slapped away off the back foot towards deep point for just a single.

Aerial but in the gap. Good length, outside off. Charith Asalanka reaches out and gets it over the jumping fielder at extra cover. The man from long off cuts it off and keeps it down to a couple. The 50 is up for Sri Lanka as well.
Marsh starts off with a short ball outside off. Asalanka powers it off the back foot over the bowler's head and picks up a couple of runs.
Mitchell Marsh comes into the attack.
On the pads, Asalanka works it through mid-wicket and collects a single.
Shorter in length again and over middle, Mendis pulls it down to deep mid-wicket for one more.
Shorter, around leg. This is clipped away behind square on the leg side for a run.

FOUR! The boundaries are starting to flow here for Sri Lanka. Speared into the pads, Asalanka gets low and looks to slog but gets it off the inner half of the bat and through backward square leg. Kane Richardson runs to his left from the square leg fence but can't cut it off.
A bit on the shorter side and angled across the right-hander. Kusal Mendis gets down on one knee and pulls it to deep square leg for one more.
Quicker one, angled onto the pads. Asalanka flicks it to short fine leg for one.
Glenn Maxwell (1-0-5-1) comes back to bowl.
Full and on off, turned through wide mid on for a single.
Around off, pushed away towards covers for a run.
Beaten! Nicely flighted from Agar, on off and the ball turns away after pitching as well. Mendis looks to drive but is beaten past the outside edge.
Smart batting from Asalanka, just rotating the strike after the boundary. Flatter and on the pads, nudged away towards square leg for one.

SIX! Aggressive shot from Asalanka and he gets maximum purchase. This is floated up around off stump, Asalanka steps down the track and goes through with the shot, dispatching it over the long on fence.
Cheeky attempt! Ashton Agar starts off with a very full delivery on middle, Charith Asalanka reverse sweeps it straight to the man at short third man.
Ashton Agar comes into the attack.
Fuller and on the pads, flicked aerially in front of square on the leg side for one. At the end of the Powerplay, Sri Lanka are 28/2!
Good running. On middle, tucked away with soft hands towards the mid-wicket region for a quick single.

Better from Kane Richardson, around the top of off and just angling in. Mendis hangs back and just nudges it towards backward and tries to steal a single. The fielder over there though is on his toes and gets onto the ball in a flash.
Length, around off, pushed away towards cover.
SIX! Nonchalant from Kusal Mendis! Overpitched from Kane Richardson, it is the slower one and outside off. Mendis gets low and lifts it over the extra cover fence for a biggie.
Kane Richardson starts off with a fullish delivery around off, Kusal Mendis caresses it towards the cover region.
Kane Richardson to bowl the final over of the Powerplay.
Swing and a miss! Shorter, outside off, much slower this one at 116 clicks. Charith Asalanka looks to pull this but he misses.
Length delivery, outside off. Charith Asalanka stays in his crease and tries to cut this away but the ball goes off the under edge towards cover.
This one nips back in, around middle, on a length. Kusal Mendis stays back and dabs it towards point. Quick singe taken!
Another slower one, outside off, length delivery. Charith Asalanka opens the face of the bat and guides it towards third man for a single.
Tad slower now, around middle and leg, on a length. Charith Asalanka taps it towards mid-wicket.
SIX! Bang! Sri Lanka will need more of these! A fuller one, right in the slot, outside off. Charith Asalanka dispatches it straight down the ground for a biggie.

Josh Hazlewood drops it short again, around off. Kusal Mendis hangs back, and hops to punch this on the off side, but the ball goes off the outside edge towards third man. Kane Richardson runs to his left and does well to stop the ball. Two taken!
Shorter ball, down the leg side. Charith Asalanka pulls it towards deep square leg. Single taken!
Angling in around middle and leg, on a length. Kusal Mendis taps it towards mid-wicket and runs across to the other end. Good running!
Length delivery, outside off, at 138 clicks. Kusal Mendis hangs back and dabs it towards slip.
Back of a length, around middle. Charith Asalanka pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Good-length delivery from over the wicket, around off. Charith Asalanka blocks it towards the off side.
Another length delivery, outside off once again. Kusal Mendis is happy to let it go through to the keeper. A successful first over for Jhye Richardson as well!
Outside off, on a length. Kusal Mendis leaves it alone.
Kusal Mendis walks out to bat now.

OUT! TAKEN! Wickets in quick succession for Australia! This is some high-risk cricket from Sri Lanka! Jhye Richardson strikes in his first over and Sri Lanka have lost their second wicket. A length ball, around middle and off. Pathum Nissanka back away, swings his bat at it, and tries to go over cover. But the ball goes off his outside edge and flies high towards third man. Mitchell Marsh takes another good catch there.
Commentary.Howout: c Mitchell Marsh b Jhye Richardson

Commentary.Commentary: Lovely shot! Tad shorter, around middle. Pathum Nissanka makes room and pulls it over mid-wicket. The ball flies high and stops just near the boundary ropes. Two taken!
This one nips back in, full in length, around middle. Pathum Nissanka works it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Jhye Richardson begins with a fuller ball, around the off pole. Pathum Nissanka pushes it towards mid off.
Change in the bowling straightaway as Jhye Richardson comes into the attack.
Back of a length, around middle and off, extra bounce there as well. Charith Asalanka does well to block it with soft hands towards point. A maiden for Josh Hazlewood!
Length delivery, around middle, at 131 clicks. Charith Asalanka blocks it out.
Swing and a miss! Shorter one now, outside off. Charith Asalanka tries to pull this but he misses.
On a length, tailing back in, around the pads, at  137 clicks. Charith Asalanka flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Back of a length, around middle and off. Charith Asalanka steps down the pitch and looks to pull this but he manages to get an inside edge back onto his pads.
Josh Hazlewood begins with a length ball, nipping back in around middle. Charith Asalanka looks to flick this but he misses and gets hit on his thigh pads.
Josh Hazlewood to bowl with the new ball from the opposite end.
Shorter ball, around middle. Pathum Nissanka knocks it towards mid-wicket. End of a successful first over from Glenn Maxwell!
Charith Asalanka comes in at number 3 for Sri Lanka.

OUT! TAKEN! Wicket in the first over for Glenn Maxwell and Australia! Danushka Gunathilaka departs for a timid score. Another fuller ball, around middle, slower through the air. Danushka Gunathilaka gets down on his knee and sweeps it to the only man in the deep on the leg side. Mitchell Marsh from deep square leg runs to his right and takes a sharp catch. Sri Lanka lose their first wicket!
Commentary.Howout: c Mitchell Marsh b Glenn Maxwell

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Crunched! Tosses it up, full, around off. Danushka Gunathilaka drives it powerfully through cover for a boundary.
Shorter now, spinning away, around off. Danushka Gunathilaka pushes it towards cover off the back foot.
Fuller, around off. Danushka Gunathilaka pushes it back to the bowler.
Glenn Maxwell begins with a loopy ball, very full, around middle. Pathum Nissanka works it away towards long on for a single. Pathum Nissanka and Sri Lanka are underway!

We are ready for play! The umpires and the players are out in the middle. Danushka Gunathilaka and Pathum Nissanka are set to open the batting for Sri Lanka. A bit of spin to start with from Australia as Glenn Maxwell has been handed the new ball. Let's play...
Dasun Shanaka says that they are focusing on changing gears in this game and 170 will be the ideal score on this wicket. Informs that they are playing with the same XI.

Aaron Finch says that they will have a bowl first. Adds that the wicket hasn't changed much from last night and they fancy themselves chasing a score. Mentions that the wicket was good and due to a bit of rain, the ball came on to the bat better. Informs that Starc is out of the game as he has a few stitches on the bowling hand and Jhye Richardson comes in to replace him. Also informs that Andrew McDonald is now onboard, he is isolated and will be with the team soon.

PITCH REPORT - Russel Arnold says that the conditions look good once again. Adds that it is the same pitch tonight as well and it is dry but hard. Reckons pacers will have more success on this pitch than the spinners and there will be good bounce on offer. Mentions that the par score still seems to be around 175.

Sri Lanka (Unchanged Playing XI) - Pathum Nissanka, Danushka Gunathilaka, Charith Asalanka, Kusal Mendis (WK), Bhanuka Rajapaksa, Dasun Shanaka (C), Wanindu Hasaranga, Chamika Karunaratne, Dushmantha Chameera, Maheesh Theekshana, Nuwan Thushara.

Australia (Playing XI) - Aaron Finch (C), David Warner, Mitchell Marsh, Glenn Maxwell, Steven Smith, Marcus Stoinis, Matthew Wade (WK), Ashton Agar, Jhye Richardson (In place of Mitchell Starc), Kane Richardson, Josh Hazlewood.
TOSS - Australia have won the toss and they have elected to BOWL first!

We did experience a bit of rain in the first T20I but thankfully, we witnessed a full game in the end. There is rain predicted once again for this game as well but let’s hope the weather remains kind to us and we face no interruptions. Stay tuned for the toss and other updates.
